user.title: Hue Extras
user.description: Add the Hue Extras actions and entities to Home Assistant. No configuration is required.

abort.already_configured: Hue Extras is already set up.

no_properties.message: Specify at least one property to change (brightness, color temperature or color).

no_hue_lights.message: No Hue lights were found in the selected target. This action only works on lights from the core Philips Hue integration.

signal_needs_two_colors.message: The 'alternating' signal requires both color and color 2.

change_light.name: Change light
change_light.description: Changes brightness, color or color temperature of Philips Hue lights without changing their on/off state. If a light is off it stays off; the new values apply the next time it turns on. Fields match light.turn_on, so this is a drop-in replacement.

transition.name: Transition
transition.description: Duration, in seconds, over which to fade to the new values.

rgb_color.name: Color
rgb_color.description: Color in RGB format. A list of three integers, each 0-255.

color_temp.name: Color temperature (mireds)
color_temp.description: White color temperature in mireds. Converted to Kelvin.

hs_color.name: Color (hue, saturation)
hs_color.description: Color in hue/saturation format. Hue 0-360, saturation 0-100.

xy_color.name: XY-color
xy_color.description: Color in XY format. A list of two floats between 0 and 1.

color_name.name: Color name
color_name.description: A human-readable CSS color name, e.g. tomato.

signal.name: Signal
signal.description: Triggers the Hue v2 signaling API on single lights and Hue grouped lights (rooms/zones).

signal.name: Signal
signal.description: The signal: on_off (blink in current color), on_off_color (blink in the given color), alternating (alternate between two colors), or no_signal (stop).

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the signal runs, in seconds. Ignored for no_signal.

color.name: Color
color.description: Color for on_off_color, and the first color for alternating.

color2.name: Color 2
color2.description: The second color for the alternating signal.
